patch:
--- a/rtl/sequence.sv
+++ b/rtl/sequence.sv
@@ -39,15 +39,17 @@
         counter_out <= #1 4'b0000;
         overflow_out <= #1 1'b0;
     end
-    //If enable is active, we increment the counter
-    else if(enable == 1'b1) begin
-        counter_out <= #1 counter_out + 1;
-
-    end
-    // if it overflows, set overflow_out to be 1
-    if(counter_out == 4'b1111 && enable == 1'b0)
-    begin
-        overflow_out <= 1'b1;
+    else begin
+        //If enable is active, we increment the counter
+        if(enable == 1'b1) begin
+            counter_out <= #1 counter_out + 1;
+        end
+        // if the pre-edge count is at its maximum, set sticky overflow
+        // independent of the enable signal
+        if(counter_out == 4'b1111)
+        begin
+            overflow_out <= 1'b1;
+        end
     end
 end // End of block COUNTER
